verdictEs: TEMPLE OSRS si quieres data-density con features modernas: collection log tracking, drop logs y rates de EHP/EHB mantenidos activamente. Crystal Math Labs si valoras la profundidad histórica y el linaje del EHP — es el tracker original que inventó el concepto y tiene el registro de más largo alcance. Ambos son para power users; eligen entre features mantenidas o historial profundo.
verdictEn: TEMPLE OSRS if you want data density with modern features: collection log tracking, drop logs, and actively maintained EHP/EHB rates. Crystal Math Labs if you value historical depth and the EHP lineage — it's the original tracker that invented the concept and holds the longest-reaching record. Both are for power users; you're choosing between maintained features or deep history.
